Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves. Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up. Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later. Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary. Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work. Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix. Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production. Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript. A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples. Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day. Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers.
